relations.name: Required evidence removal is non-improving
relations.invariant: Removing a required support item must never move a blocked or open decision toward closure.
relations.oracle: Independent Decision Closure evaluation plus exact support-reference receipt.

relations.name: Evidence lifecycle changes cannot increase validity
relations.invariant: Expiry, revocation, supersession, correction, or withdrawal cannot increase downstream evidence validity.
relations.oracle: Evidence Lineage replay and owner-native freshness/lease evaluation; preserve historical disposition.

relations.name: Common-cause grouping cannot inflate independence
relations.invariant: Merging two previously distinct observations into one owner-qualified common-cause group cannot increase the independent-support count.
relations.oracle: Independent provenance/common-cause assessor; never infer independence from identifiers.

relations.name: Evidence applicability is confined to exact context
relations.invariant: Changing any material use-context dimension makes previous evidence inapplicable to the changed scope unless separately requalified.
relations.oracle: Context and applicability owner checks against exact digest-pinned scope.

relations.name: Authorized denominator expansion cannot improve action coverage
relations.invariant: Increasing the authorized expected-action denominator without adding observed actions cannot improve completion or coverage.
relations.oracle: Frozen authorized work-package scope and action-coverage evaluator.

relations.name: Provider assertion cannot become a physical observation
relations.invariant: A provider completion or dashboard acknowledgement alone never satisfies independent physical restoration.
relations.oracle: Independent observation evaluator and exact source-origin grouping.

relations.name: Pending or contradictory quality evidence cannot close
relations.invariant: A required pending, contradicted, or not-assessable water-quality result cannot be promoted to passed or closed.
relations.oracle: Claim Support and conclusion-relative Decision Closure with approved laboratory evidence owner.

relations.name: Authority revocation cannot improve execution eligibility
relations.invariant: Revoking a permit, crew qualification, or local authority cannot improve the eligibility of execution or closure.
relations.oracle: Credential, permit and authority owners; exact scope, revision and revocation evidence.

relations.name: NotAffected determinations do not generalize
relations.invariant: A NotAffected determination applies only to the exact reviewed event, artifact revision, dependency edge and use context.
relations.oracle: Impact Qualification with exact event/artifact/edge/context digest and independent review refs.

relations.name: Event replay and sequence semantics are deterministic
relations.invariant: Identical event replay is idempotent; conflicting event-ID reuse rejects; event arrival order does not override host-assigned sequence.
relations.oracle: Evidence Lineage deterministic replay receipt and independent event-stream oracle.

relations.name: Informational dependencies do not blanket-invalidate
relations.invariant: A dependency explicitly designated Informational does not invalidate or require revalidation solely because its target changes.
relations.oracle: Evidence Lineage with frozen relation semantics.

relations.name: Alternative support cannot be mixed across alternatives
relations.invariant: AnyOf support succeeds only when one complete declared alternative support set is satisfied; partial fragments from different alternatives cannot be combined.
relations.oracle: Independent support-set evaluator with complete-set known answers.

relations.name: Review eligibility is not authority closure
relations.invariant: Eligible for local review is not equivalent to closed, authorized, or executed.
relations.oracle: Decision Closure plus exact local authority decision reference.

relations.name: Operational timestamps remain semantically distinct
relations.invariant: First response, repair completion, pressure restoration, quality clearance and authority closure cannot be silently collapsed into one timestamp or metric.

relations.name: Semantically unordered inputs preserve replay output
relations.invariant: Permuting semantically unordered evidence or graph node input order must preserve the canonical evaluation and receipt.
relations.oracle: Byte-stable canonical serialization and independent replay.

relations.name: AI-generated proposal is not consent or authority
relations.invariant: Generated text, model confidence, or inferred consensus cannot substitute for authenticated human assent, delegation, or authority.
relations.oracle: Need Intake, Project Formation and host-authenticated authority records.

relations.name: Minimal lawful counterfactual repair plan is complete and non-bypassing
relations.invariant: For an open decision, a repair plan identifies every currently material blocker, its owner and prerequisite, and only lawful ways to address it; it never changes the decision state or bypasses safety/authority requirements.
relations.oracle: Decision Closure, Claim Support and authority owners; independently compare the plan with the exact material-element dependency graph.

relations.name: Attributed material dissent is preserved without fabricated consensus
relations.invariant: Every material stakeholder position remains separately attributable through summaries and revisions; positions may be reconciled only by an authenticated, explicitly scoped community decision.
relations.oracle: Need Intake exact position provenance, reviewer authority and revision history.
